tuned_on: val, human-verified lines only (data/annotations/verified_lines.tsv, 1067 usable lines); test and test_unseen not inspected before freezing

utrnet_w800.why: w800 beat w400 on val (verified CER 15.2 vs 17.7), mostly on very wide lines

hybrid_final.rule: Tesseract eng if UTRNet's prediction has no Urdu letter (A), or Tesseract's mean word confidence >= 70 and its text has a Latin letter or digit (B); else UTRNet
